diagnosis: The FRED RISK_ON gate genuinely improved OOS risk-adjusted performance on the full-universe momentum core (charter bar PASS: 74.5% CAGR / 1.59 Sharpe vs SPY 22.3% / 1.34) but the claim is conjunctive and EVERY statistical gate failed: IS significance p=0.586 (no in-sample edge), 14/62 CPCV combinations negative with fold-4 worst, cumulative excess Sharpe of -2.75 through the fold ending 2025-06-30 (the OOS win arrived late and concentrated, max incremental fold share 0.595 just under cap), and permutation-null survival missed (observed 1.261 vs null p95 1.326). Pattern matches cycle5_c6 prior FAIL: same regime source, gate timing luck rather than a stable edge. Verdict FAIL per kill criteria; no re-tuning of thresholds, no per-label rescues, no post-hoc lag changes permitted.
